lessons.title: Reading: The Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
lessons.context: A short passage discussing the ethical questions raised by AI.

paragraphs.uz: Sun'iy intellektning jadal rivojlanishi yangi axloqiy savollarni keltirib chiqarmoqda.
paragraphs.en: The rapid development of artificial intelligence is raising new ethical questions.

paragraphs.uz: Ba'zi mutaxassislar bu texnologiya ish o'rinlarini yo'qotishga olib kelishi mumkinligidan xavotirda.
paragraphs.en: Some experts are concerned that this technology could lead to job losses.

paragraphs.uz: Boshqalar esa sun'iy intellekt yangi imkoniyatlar yaratishiga ishonishadi.
paragraphs.en: Others, however, believe artificial intelligence will create new opportunities.

paragraphs.uz: Bu texnologiyadan qanday foydalanish kerakligi haqida aniq qoidalar zarur.
paragraphs.en: Clear rules are needed regarding how this technology should be used.

paragraphs.uz: Shaffoflik va mas'uliyat bu jarayonning markazida turishi lozim.
paragraphs.en: Transparency and responsibility must be at the center of this process.

paragraphs.uz: Ko'plab davlatlar bu borada qonunchilikni ishlab chiqmoqda.
paragraphs.en: Many countries are developing legislation in this area.

paragraphs.uz: Kelajakda inson va texnologiya o'rtasidagi muvozanat muhim bo'lib qoladi.
paragraphs.en: In the future, the balance between humans and technology will remain important.

questions.question: Matnga ko'ra, nima jarayonning markazida turishi kerak?
